description: This file defines the main activity of an Android application providing user login, sign-up, and calculator functionalities within a single activity. It manages UI components, user authentication, and simple arithmetic operations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity class handling user authentication, navigation between login, sign-up, and calculator screens, and performing basic arithmetic calculations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets event listeners, seeds an example account, and shows the login screen.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates class variables with UI components via `findViewById`.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Sets click listeners on various buttons to handle navigation and user actions.

methods.name: showLogin
methods.description: Displays the login UI and hides others.

methods.name: showSignUp
methods.description: Displays the sign-up UI and hides others.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Displays the calculator/dashboard UI after successful login, greeting the user.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates credentials and navigates to the dashboard upon success.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Validates new user data, registers user, and navigates to the dashboard.

methods.name: clearCalculatorState
methods.description: Resets calculator input fields and result display.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operations on inputs and updates the UI with results.

methods.name: parseDoubleOrNull
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a Double, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double for display, removing unnecessary decimal points.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Performs a basic validation of email format.
